What We Do Best

Twelve Ways to Travel
Exceptionally Well

Every trip we build falls into one of these categories — and every one of them is designed around you, not around inventory.

Sport & Unique Access

Sports & Event Travel

A Monaco paddock pass and three nights at the Hôtel de Paris. A guaranteed tee time at Augusta National. Front-row seats at Wimbledon with hospitality that doesn't feel like a conference. Elite sporting access is a specialty — and the logistics require someone who's done it before.

Notable Events
Monaco Grand PrixThe MastersWimbledonPebble Beach

Sand & Sea

Beach & Island Escapes

Not every beach is the same. Grace Bay in Turks & Caicos and a public beach in Cancún are both technically tropical, but they are entirely different experiences. We know which stretches of sand are worth the travel — and which properties actually have access to them.

Popular Destinations
Turks & CaicosMaldivesSeychellesSt. Barth'sBora Bora

Resort & Inclusive

All-Inclusive Vacations

Not all all-inclusives are created equal — and most people find that out after they've booked. We know which resorts actually deliver on the promise: the food, the service, the rooms, the beach. And which ones look excellent in photos and disappoint on arrival.

MexicoCaribbeanMaldivesAdults-Only

Family

Family Travel

The kids are engaged. The parents aren't managing logistics. Family travel has more variables than almost anything else we plan — and getting those variables right requires knowing exactly which properties, guides, and itineraries handle it well.

Popular Destinations
Costa RicaTurks & CaicosJapanBanff
Explore Family Travel
Multigenerational

Multigenerational Travel

Three generations, one trip, no compromises. The grandparents are comfortable. The teenagers aren't bored. The parents have nothing on their plate. A private villa with dedicated staff, an itinerary that branches — these are the tools that make it work.

Popular Formats
Private VillasFamily ReunionsMilestone Trips
Explore Multigenerational Travel
Active & Outdoor

Adventure & Active Travel

Ski-in access in Verbier. Trekking in Patagonia with a private guide. Scuba diving in the Coral Triangle with a liveaboard crew who know the reefs by name. Active travel at the luxury level — where the adventure is extraordinary and the evening is just as good.

Popular Experiences
SkiingTrekkingDivingExpeditions
Explore Adventure & Active Travel
Wellbeing

Wellness & Retreat Travel

Not a spa weekend — a genuine reset. The kind of place where the programme is designed around you, the food is actually restorative, and you return home having changed something. We know which wellness properties actually work.

Popular Destinations
BaliThailandMaldivesSwitzerland
Explore Wellness & Retreat Travel
Culture & Discovery

Culture & Immersive Travel

A private tour of the Vatican before it opens. A monastery road trip through Bhutan's Bumthang Valley. A week in Kyoto with a local guide who's spent thirty years navigating it. Immersive travel is about access — to people, places, and perspectives most itineraries never reach.

Popular Destinations
BhutanKyotoRomeOman
Explore Culture & Immersive Travel
Culinary

Food & Wine Travel

A Burgundy cellar that isn't on any tasting tour. A kaiseki counter in Kyoto with a six-month waiting list. A cooking lesson in Bologna with someone who's been making pasta the same way since 1963. Food travel is about access — and access is what we do.

Popular Destinations
BurgundyKyotoBolognaSan Sebastián
Explore Food & Wine Travel
Sea & River

Cruises

Seven days, eight islands, one crew who knows every hidden cove between Santorini and Patmos. Or a river cruise through Burgundy in harvest season. Not all cruises are the same — the vessel, the route, and the season change everything.

Popular Routes
Ocean CruisesRiver CruisesSmall-ShipYacht Charters

Romance & Celebration

Romance & Celebration Travel

The villa sits on a coral cliff above Petit Cul-de-Sac. Everything is arranged before you land. Honeymoons, anniversaries, proposals, babymoons, landmark birthdays — these are the trips where everything has to be right, and we treat them accordingly.

HoneymoonsAnniversariesProposalsBabymoons

Africa & Beyond

Safari & Wildlife

Moremi in shoulder season — when the herds are still there and the camps are at half capacity. Your guide has been here thirty years. He knows where the leopard sleeps and which waterhole the elephants prefer at dusk. That knowledge is not available on a booking engine.

Botswana · Moremi Game Reserve
Currently Featured

Safari & Wildlife —
Africa Done Right

The difference between a good safari and an exceptional one is almost entirely the camp and the guide. We hold a direct relationship with every camp we recommend in Botswana, Kenya, Tanzania, South Africa, and Rwanda, and we debrief every client who comes back from one.

Shoulder season. Smaller camps. Guides who've been doing this for decades. That's the brief we work from.
